text: Gold rose about 1.1% to $4,059 after a morning dip toward $4,000, moving away from last week's three-month low.
Gold miners outpaced gold: GDX closed up 2.7% at $83.19.
Silver gained about 0.7% to $54.20; SLV closed up 1.0% and AGQ up 2.1%.
Brent settled down $1.93 at $113.88, its second straight drop, as talks involving Iran eased supply fears.
Tech led stocks higher: the Nasdaq rose 1.2% and the S&P 500 0.6%; QQQ closed up 1.3% and TQQQ up 3.8%.
The VIX fell 0.87 points to 17.52 as tech stocks rallied.
Treasury yields edged up as the Fed meeting began: the 10-year near 5.00% and the 2-year near 4.74%.
The yen weakened for a third day to about 157.7 per dollar ahead of the Fed and Bank of Japan decisions.
